_readme: 集成示例：一个连接器 = 一个插件集 + 多个运行环境(source)。同一个 mysql 插件被多个环境复用，各环境通过 access 引用可复用的权限档(profile)，个别环境再内联微调。授权对象是连接目标(source)本身，无角色。改 cwd/密码后合并进 千问办公 MCP 配置；默认最安全(prod 类只读)。

_env_notes.DB_ACCESS_PROFILES: 权限档字典(JSON)。可复用：缓存一档、业务库一档。
_env_notes.DB_SOURCES: 环境列表(JSON)。每项 access 可为：档名字符串 / 内联 dict / {"profile":"档名", ...覆盖}。

env.DB_SOURCES: [{"name":"mysql8-prod","dialect":"mysql","host":"127.0.0.1","port":3306,"user":"app_ro","password":"<生产只读账号密码>","database":"biz","access":"prod"},{"name":"mysql57-sandbox","dialect":"mysql","host":"127.0.0.1","port":3307,"user":"root","password":"<测试库密码>","database":"legacy","access":"sandbox"},{"name":"mysql8-docker","dialect":"mysql","host":"127.0.0.1","port":3308,"user":"root","password":"<容器测试密码>","database":"dockertest","access":"sandbox"},{"name":"redis-cache","dialect":"redis","host":"127.0.0.1","port":6379,"database":"0","access":"cache"},{"name":"redis-sessions","dialect":"redis","host":"127.0.0.1","port":6379,"database":"1","access":"prod"},{"name":"mongo-analytics","dialect":"mongodb","host":"127.0.0.1","port":27017,"database":"analytics","access":"report"},{"name":"mysql8-prod-strict","dialect":"mysql","host":"127.0.0.1","port":3306,"user":"app","password":"<密码>","database":"biz","access":{"profile":"prod","write_deny":["audit_log","user_credential"]}}]
env.DB_CONFIRM_SECRET: <随机串;不设则每进程随机、重启即作废>

_source_legend.mysql8-prod / mysql8-prod-strict: 生产(8.0) → prod 档：只读；写/DROP 需确认令牌；strict 版再禁写 audit_log/user_credential
_source_legend.mysql57-sandbox / mysql8-docker: 测试(5.7:3307 / docker:3308) → sandbox 档：给到破坏性、免确认（同插件不同环境不同权限）
_source_legend.redis-cache: 缓存 → cache 档：读+数据写
_source_legend.redis-sessions: 会话 → prod 档：只读为主
